children: The Singapore dollar strengthens slightly against its U.S. counterpart in Asia amid mild risk appetite. Asian equities are broadly higher Friday, tracking gains in U.S. stock futures as market sentiment around artificial intelligence stabilizes. Markets will be watching for commentary from the Federal Reserve after the latest U.S. PCE data, with money markets currently pricing approximately 69 bps of additional Fed hikes by mid-2027, UOB's Global Economics & Markets Research team says in a note. The U.S. dollar is 0.1% lower at 1.2893 Singapore dollars, LSEG data show.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
